step1.title: Drop your file
step1.desc: Drag and drop or click to upload. PDF, JPG, PNG, or WebP.

step2.title: Choose your action
step2.desc: Pick a tool — merge, split, convert — or let us suggest one based on your file.

step3.title: Get your result
step3.desc: Download the processed file. Client-side tools are instant; server-side take a few seconds.
